hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.lead: These terms govern your access to and use of MCPEmails. By creating an account or using the service you agree to be bound by them. Please read them carefully.

serviceDescription.title: 2. Description of Service
serviceDescription.p1: MCPEmails provides a software-as-a-service platform that allows you to connect email accounts (Gmail, Microsoft Outlook, Fastmail, and compatible IMAP accounts) and expose those accounts to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The Service includes:
list: A web dashboard for managing connected email accounts, API keys, and usage monitoring.
An MCP-compliant HTTP endpoint that AI agents authenticate against using API keys you generate.
OAuth integration with supported email providers to obtain and manage delegated access to your mailboxes.
A usage and audit log showing which tools your agents have called and when.
serviceDescription.p2: MCPEmails acts as a protocol bridge. We do not store email content on our servers; we retrieve it live from your email provider at the moment an agent requests it and return it in the same HTTP response. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for a full description of what data we do and do not retain.
serviceDescription.p2b: Email content is delivered only to the MCP client or AI agent that you have connected and choose to use. Once content reaches that client, it is governed by that client's or AI provider's own privacy policy and terms, which you are responsible for reviewing. MCPEmails does not select an AI provider on your behalf and retains no copy of your email content.
serviceDescription.p3: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the Service at any time. Where practicable we will give at least 30 days' notice of material changes to paid users.

accountRegistration.p31: You must register for an account to use most features of the Service. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to keep that information up to date. Accounts registered with false, inaccurate, or misleading information may be suspended or terminated without notice.
accountRegistration.p32: Each account is for the use of one individual or one legal entity. You may not share login credentials with other people or create multiple accounts to circumvent plan limits or other restrictions.
accountRegistration.p33: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials, including your password and any API keys you generate. You must notify us immediately at <email></email> if you suspect unauthorised access to your account. MCPEmails is not liable for any loss or damage arising from your failure to maintain the security of your credentials.
accountRegistration.p34: API keys you generate grant access to the MCP endpoint on your behalf. You are solely responsible for all actions taken using keys you have generated, including actions taken by AI agents to which you have provided those keys. Treat API keys as secrets. Revoke any key that you suspect has been compromised.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.p41: You may use the Service for any lawful purpose that is consistent with these Terms. Typical permitted uses include connecting your own email accounts, generating API keys for AI agents you operate, and building applications or workflows for yourself or your organisation.
acceptableUse.p42: You must not use the Service, directly or indirectly, for any of the following:
list: Unauthorised access. Connecting email accounts that you do not own or are not authorised to access on behalf of the account holder.
Spam and bulk messaging. Sending unsolicited commercial email, bulk email, or any message that violates the CAN-SPAM Act, CASL, the EU's ePrivacy Directive, or equivalent laws in your jurisdiction.

Phishing and fraud. Sending messages that impersonate another person or organisation, or that are designed to deceive recipients into revealing credentials, financial details, or other sensitive information.
Malware distribution. Sending email containing malicious code, ransomware, spyware, or any other software designed to damage or gain unauthorised access to a recipient's device or data.
Harassment and abuse. Using the Service to threaten, harass, intimidate, stalk, or harm any individual.

Illegal content. Transmitting, storing, or accessing content that is illegal under applicable law, including content that infringes intellectual property rights, violates privacy laws, or constitutes child sexual abuse material (CSAM).
Circumvention. Attempting to circumvent authentication, rate limits, access controls, or any other security measure of the Service or of any third-party service (including email providers).
Reverse engineering. Attempting to decompile, disassemble, reverse-engineer, or otherwise derive the source code of the Service.
Interference. Introducing viruses, denial-of-service attacks, or any other code or action that interferes with the operation of the Service or its infrastructure.
Reselling without permission. Reselling or sublicensing access to the Service to third parties without our prior written consent.
Automated scraping. Using the Service to scrape or harvest email data at scale for purposes other than your own legitimate agent-driven workflow.
acceptableUse.p43: You are responsible for the actions of any AI agent or automated system that accesses the Service using an API key you have generated. This includes actions that the agent takes autonomously. You must ensure that agents operating under your API keys comply with these Terms and with applicable law.
acceptableUse.p44: You must comply with the terms of service and API policies of any email provider whose account you connect to MCPEmails (including Google, Microsoft, and Fastmail). MCPEmails is not responsible for any suspension or restriction of your email account by a third-party provider.
acceptableUse.p45: We reserve the right to investigate suspected violations of these rules. If we determine, in our sole discretion, that you have violated this section, we may suspend or terminate your account, remove or disable access to specific API keys or connected inboxes, and report violations to law enforcement authorities where required by law or where we deem it appropriate to protect others.

plansAndPayment.title: 5. Plans, Fees, and Payment
plansAndPayment.p51: The Free plan is provided at no charge and is subject to the usage limits described on our <pricing>Pricing page</pricing>. We reserve the right to change or discontinue the Free plan with 30 days' notice.
plansAndPayment.p52: Paid plans are billed monthly or annually in advance. By subscribing to a paid plan you authorise us to charge the payment method on file at the start of each billing period. All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, which will be added where required by law.
plansAndPayment.p53: You may upgrade your plan at any time; the new rate takes effect immediately and is prorated for the remainder of the current billing period. Downgrading takes effect at the start of the next billing period. Features that exceed the new plan's limits will be disabled at the downgrade date.
plansAndPayment.p54: Payments for monthly plans are non-refundable except where required by applicable consumer protection law. For annual plans, you may request a prorated refund for unused complete months within 14 days of your renewal date by contacting us at <email></email>.
plansAndPayment.p55: If a payment fails, we will retry the charge and notify you by email. If payment remains outstanding after 7 days, we may suspend access to paid features until the balance is settled. If payment remains outstanding after 30 days, we may terminate the account in accordance with Section 8.
plansAndPayment.p56: We may change pricing for paid plans with at least 30 days' written notice to your registered email address. Price changes will not apply until your next renewal date.
plansAndPayment.p57a: To protect platform stability and ensure fair access for all customers, the Service applies a per-minute request rate limit to every plan (a “fair-use limit”), as described on our <pricing>Pricing page</pricing>. We may also apply reasonable technical measures to prevent abuse, automated scraping, or usage that materially degrades the Service for others.
plansAndPayment.p57b: Where a plan is described as “unlimited,” that refers to the absence of fixed monthly usage quotas; it remains subject to this fair-use limit and to Section 4 (Acceptable Use). We reserve the right to introduce, change, or remove usage limits and fair-use thresholds for any plan, including the Free plan, on a going-forward basis. We will give at least 30 days' notice to your registered email address before a change takes effect for your workspace, and may apply new limits to new subscriptions immediately.

accountTermination.title: 8. Account Termination
accountTermination.p81a: You may close your account at any time by navigating to Dashboard → Settings → Delete Account and following the confirmation steps. Account deletion is permanent. All connected inbox configurations, API keys, and audit logs associated with your workspace will be deleted within 30 days of the deletion request.
accountTermination.p81b: If you are on a paid plan, closing your account stops future billing but does not entitle you to a refund of any amounts already charged, except as described in Section 5.4.
accountTermination.p82: We may suspend or terminate your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, if:
list82: You violate Section 4 (Acceptable Use) or any other material provision of these Terms.
We are required to do so by law, court order, or regulatory authority.
Your use of the Service poses a risk to the security, integrity, or availability of the Service or to other users.
You provide false, inaccurate, or fraudulent information during registration or at any subsequent time.
Payment for a paid plan remains outstanding for more than 30 days after the due date.
accountTermination.p82after: Where termination for cause results in the deletion of your account, we will not provide a refund for any unused portion of a paid subscription.
accountTermination.p83: We may terminate your account for any reason not covered by Section 8.2 by providing at least 30 days' written notice to your registered email address. In the event of such termination, we will provide a prorated refund for any unused portion of a prepaid annual subscription.
accountTermination.p84: In lieu of immediate termination we may, at our discretion, temporarily suspend your access to the Service while we investigate a suspected violation. We will attempt to provide notice of suspension unless doing so would prejudice an ongoing investigation or is prohibited by law.
accountTermination.p85: Upon termination of your account for any reason:

All API keys associated with your account are immediately revoked.
OAuth token grants issued to MCPEmails by your email provider are revoked; your email provider may take up to 24 hours to reflect this.
Your data will be deleted in accordance with our retention schedule described in the Privacy Policy.
